build: Built from a clean `git archive` export of 07a6e1ab6479bbee39ad345aa08200d42e5db1f4. Release build of the ejm-cli binary, with its `../ejm-harness` path dependencies resolved to a clean export of ejm-harness a96c9928a98045c79beff0ea832ff964fb2eac85.
